title: MCP Automation T2 Desktop Control
desc: Desktop control tier for WKAppBot MCP. Covers a11y, win-click, caller HWND routing, and the Standard AppBot Window rules that keep desktop automation stable.
steps: Use a11y and win-click as the primary desktop automation surfaces through wkappbot_cli.
Respect Standard AppBot Window rules for caller HWND, ancestor walk, and IPC forwarding.
Prefer focusless or admin-proxy routes when elevated targets or hidden windows are involved.
author: claude
